Question B-005-001-004.

Why the correct answer is right: A microfarad is 1 000 000 picofarads. So 1 000 000 pF is 1 microfarad.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "10 microfarads": That shifts the decimal one place too far right during the pF-to-microfarad conversion.
- sourceIndex 2: "0.01 microfarads": This is one hundred times too small.
- sourceIndex 3: "0.001 microfarads": This is one thousand times too small.
